sources.title: omp — a coding agent with the IDE wired in
sources.snippet: omp is a coding agent for the terminal: subagents, plan mode, LSP, DAP, hindsight memory, hashline edits, and time-traveling rules — with a native Rust engine doing the heavy lifting.
